requirements.label: Romance Philology or Comparative Romance Linguistics
requirements.hint: One course of at least 3 credits in the linguistics of the Romance languages, preferably of a comparative nature, per the LSA bulletin RLL major page and the RLL Major Worksheet (as of FA25) on the RLL department site. ROMLING (Romance Linguistics) is the department's subject for these courses, and effective Winter 2027 the bulletin names ROMLING 300 (Introduction to the Romance Languages) as the course, with alternatives arranged through the RLL major advisor when it is not offered. Romance linguistics courses under other subjects, such as FRENCH 336, may count with advisor approval.

requirements.label: ROMLANG 498: Senior Seminar in Romance Languages and Literatures
requirements.hint: RLL Senior Seminar.

requirements.label: 33 Credits in Target Languages
requirements.hint: 33 credits taught in the target languages (French, Italian, Portuguese, Spanish, or Catalan) in courses beyond the language prerequisite that would also count toward the individual language majors and minors, per the LSA bulletin RLL major page and the RLL Major Worksheet (as of FA25). Elementary and second year courses (100 through 232), SPANISH 277 and 278, and PORTUG 280 are prerequisites and do not count, and courses taught in English (such as FRENCH 240 to 249, 340 to 349, 440 to 449, and English taught ITALIAN courses) do not count. Choose two principal languages with the RLL advisor: minimum 12 credits in each, 6 upper level credits in each (300 or above in French and Italian, 281 or above in Portuguese, 400 or above in Spanish and Catalan), 15 of the 33 credits upper level overall, and up to 9 credits may come from a third Romance language. RCLANG 324 may be used toward the Spanish 279 to 399 level portion. The same course cannot satisfy both this and another major requirement.

requirements.label: Major Total: 39 Credits
requirements.hint: Includes all courses used toward the major requirements: the 33 target language credits, the Romance linguistics course, and ROMLANG 498 (plus ROMLANG 491 and 492 for Honors majors). Advisor approved cognates from other departments also count. Does not include prerequisites. Per the LSA bulletin RLL major page and the RLL Major Worksheet (as of FA25).

requirements.label: Major Residency: 21 Credits
requirements.hint: Minimum 21 major credits taken on the U-M campus or through an approved study abroad program affiliated with U-M.
